name: Chicken katsu curry
steps: Dip the chicken breast in beaten egg, then coat in panko breadcrumbs.
Fry in the oil over medium heat until golden and cooked through.
Simmer the grated carrot in a little water with curry spices to make a sauce.
Slice the crispy chicken into strips.
Plate the cooked rice and lay the chicken on top.
Pour the warm curry sauce over and serve.
